- Branch: `main`
- Commit: `b1babc26283c24c6f963ac396b0565db9c737f98`

- License: MIT (`third_party/Modern.Forms/license.md`)

The clone retains its own Git metadata so upstream history and updates can be
inspected without pretending the source is authored by this project. If it is
adopted, the actual dependency mode—package, submodule, pinned fork, or vendored
snapshot—requires an explicit architecture decision.
